_comment: WAF custom rules for the tcatlas.org zone (phase http_request_firewall_custom, entrypoint ruleset) - mirrors the live dashboard. Rule 1 added 2026-09-23; rule 2 applied 2026-09-30 and verified (scraper UA + no referer -> 403, same UA with a tcatlas referer -> 200). Apply changes by PUTting the WHOLE rules array to /zones/{zone}/rulesets/{ruleset_id} (the per-rule endpoint 10405s with the cloudflare-rules-token), or edit in Security > Security rules and update this file. NOT covered here: the zone also has one rate-limiting rule (phase http_ratelimit, free-plan limit 1/1) 'tc-atlas: throttle band-raw-frame scraper bursts at edge' - hostname api.tcatlas.org and URI path ends with band-raw-frame, action Block.

rules.description: Block referer-less headless Chrome/124 scraping storm IR frames (on-demand full-disk renders, 2026-09-30)
rules.expression: (http.host eq "api.tcatlas.org" and starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/ir-monitor/storm/") and (ends_with(http.request.uri.path, "/ir-frame.jpg") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, "/ir-frames-meta")) and http.referer eq "" and http.user_agent contains "X11; Linux x86_64" and http.user_agent contains "Chrome/124.0")
